edge_cases.description: Medical condition claimed requires clinical verification
edge_cases.action: Route to GP verification. Clinical evidence must be provided within 28 days.

edge_cases.description: DWP benefit status check returns pending or unclear result
edge_cases.action: Handoff to manual verification. Applicant should contact DWP to confirm benefit status.

edge_cases.description: Medical condition may be temporary rather than qualifying permanent condition
edge_cases.action: Handoff to clinical assessment. Exemption may be time-limited pending review.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has war pension exemption certificate for prescribed condition
edge_cases.action: Route to specialist verification. War pension office confirmation required.
